# 🔎 RAG Retrievers & Rerankers Directory

![version](https://img.shields.io/badge/version-0.1.0-blue) ![tools](https://img.shields.io/badge/tools-13-green) ![open%20source](https://img.shields.io/badge/open%20source-10-brightgreen) ![categories](https://img.shields.io/badge/categories-5-purple) [![CI](https://github.com/Amarel-Taylor-Scott/rag-retrievers-rerankers-directory/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/Amarel-Taylor-Scott/rag-retrievers-rerankers-directory/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](LICENSE)

> A curated, machine-readable directory of the **retrieval + reranking** layer of RAG — sparse/lexical retrieval, late-interaction retrieval, reranker libraries, open-weight reranker models, and managed reranking APIs.

Distinct from RAG *frameworks* (orchestration), *embedding models* (the vectors), and *vector databases* (storage): these tools *find and re-order* the most relevant passages. Ships a small CLI to search/filter/export.

## Quick start

```bash
pip install -e .                 # stdlib-only; no runtime deps
retriever-dir list               # list all
retriever-dir list --open-source # only OSS tools
retriever-dir list --category reranker_lib
retriever-dir search colbert     # search name/org/note/tags
retriever-dir export --format csv > retrievers.csv
retriever-dir generate           # regenerate this README
```

## Choosing one (rules of thumb)

- **Lexical baseline:** rank_bm25, BM25S, Pyserini.
- **Strong neural retrieval:** ColBERT / RAGatouille (late interaction).
- **Rerank your top-k:** rerankers, FlashRank, Sentence-Transformers cross-encoders.
- **Don't run infra (hosted):** Cohere Rerank, Voyage AI, Jina Reranker.
